maria.k: Heads-up: image scan flagged 'libavc' v1.2.3 -> CVE-2025-9999. Might be a fuzzy-match on the package name. SBOM location below. Anyone on call? @sec @oncall :eyes:

sec-bot: [automated scan] grype v0.20 - finding: CVE-2025-9999 -> /layers/sha256:abc123.../libavc-1.2.3 (match_score: 0.82, rule: name_similarity)

joshua: Thanks. Can you paste the SBOM path and the exact image tag?

maria.k: image: registry.redwood.internal/runner:2026-03-19-9fae
SBOM: /artifacts/runner/2026-03-19/sbom.json

selena: Quick check — looks like this comes from `lib-avc` (vendor fork) vs `libavc`. Fuzzy name match likely. Run: `jq '.components[] | select(.name|test("libavc";"i"))' sbom.json` and paste output

joshua: Ran locally, output: ```{ "name": "lib-avc", "version": "1.2.3", "purl": "pkg:npm/lib-avc@1.2.3" }``` so it's a different package. Probable false-positive. :thumbsup:

ryan: Let's quarantine the image until we confirm. I'll add a temporary policy to block deploys referencing that digest and notify infra. /cc @eng-oncall

maria.k: +1. Action plan: (1) mark finding false-positive in ticket, (2) update SBOM generation to always include canonical purl and namespace, (3) add grype suppress rule for vendor forks, (4) unblock after SBOM/scan updates.

nina: Also recommend we require SBOM signing via KMS for CI artifacts. If purl is missing, fail the build. I'll open an infra PR to enforce `purl` presence and KMS signing. :memo:

selena: Small helper check to add to CI: ```jq '[.components[] | select(.name|test("lib[-]?avc";"i"))] | length' sbom.json``` — if >1 then route for manual triage (possible forks).

joshua: Filing ticket SEC-7892: "runner image: grype fuzzy-match false-positive (lib-avc)" — assigning to eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEC-7892

maria.k: Thanks all. Note for post-incident work: add SBOM checksum to image metadata and sign SBOM with KMS; add audit log entry when suppress rules are created. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Incident status updated: severity=low, status=triaged, action_items_created=[SEC-7892], notifier=eng-security-bot
